MICRO1-PS2-Q03.answer: buyer price minus seller price equals tax; quantity falls; deadweight loss increases
solution_steps: Shift the wedge between buyer and seller prices by t.
The lost mutually beneficial trades create a positive deadweight-loss triangle.

MICRO1-PS2-Q04.answer: social MC above private MC; Pigouvian tax can internalize the external cost
solution_steps: SMC = PMC + marginal external cost, so SMC lies above PMC.
A Pigouvian tax equal to marginal external cost aligns private and social incentives.

MICRO1-PS2-Q05.answer: Qd>Qs creates a shortage; queues/rationing may allocate units
solution_steps: At the ceiling, Qd exceeds Qs.
Shortage = Qd−Qs; queues or rationing allocate the scarce quantity.
